title: JAK'D Dripping Desserts Butterscotch & Custard 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dripping Desserts Butterscotch & Custard captures the soothing, warm sweetness of butterscotch to perfection, then adds an extra indulgent layer of silky, creamy custard flavour for a truly timeless flavour profile that makes for an easy, all-day vape. Crafted for vapers who demand an intense flavour experience, Jak'd by the renowned UK brand Jak’d Rabbit goes beyond the typical e-liquid. Each Jak’d bottle is packed with a double-concentrated flavour shot, ensuring an exceptionally tasty and satisfying vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids due to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. The nicotine from Nic Salt e-liquids is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The unique magic of Nic Salts means that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration.
